initialExam.title: SBI Clerk (Junior Associate) 2026
initialExam.description: SBI Junior Associate (Clerk) exam for clerical cadre positions in State Bank of India branches. Notification expected July 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: English (30Q), Numerical Ability (35Q), Reasoning (35Q). Mains: GK (50Q), English (40Q), Quant (50Q), Reasoning/Computer (50Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 100 questions, 100 marks, 1 hour. Mains: 190 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours 40 min.
initialExam.jobRole: Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) in SBI branches
initialExam.careerGrowth: Clerk → Officer (through internal exam) → Manager → higher posts.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit sbi.co.in/careers 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit

salaryRange.description: Basic Pay (12th Bipartite Settlement) + DA + HRA

initialExam.perks: Medical insurance, LFC, Concessional loans, Leave benefits
